summarize the meeting minutes without me.template: Role-addressed forwarding PACKAGE (never person-addressed). Two docs: email + objectives. Lead with what retires the discount. Reader-utility sentence explicit. GATEKEEPER/SCHEDULING: route only diary logistics through the EA; keep substance on the principal's own thread; ISSUE the invite from authority (make declining the action); offer ONE fixed window (institutional scarcity, no availability-spray); every send delivers a FACT not a request for time; follow-ups carry new institutional facts, never 'just checking in'. TTL = 3 structured attempts (rotate key/vector) per node before logging it dead this cycle. Schedule the follow-up the moment a send fires (self-prompt + calendar). ENGAGEMENT INTERLOCK (run before any high-stakes send): name THIS engagement's playbook, THEIR likely playbook, and OURS (library: TIME-SAVER · INDEPENDENCE-TRAP · COMPETENCE-CONCESSION · STEALTH-HOOPER · EVENT-ORGANIZER · FIVE-MINUTE-BRIEF · FULL-DISCLOSURE-DM · WEATHER-FRONT · AUTHORITY-LEDGER · PATTERN-SUCCESSION). Run the 5-point gauntlet: concession (concede the software build, fight for the liability layer) · SOX+EU-AI-Act evidence (the insured cannot certify its own innocence) · hardware-primitive lockout (software cannot audit software) · mechanism-not-boast (runs locally via npx, data never leaves the building) · price-documented ($20/agent-year in the docs, never dumped). If the draft's shape compresses toward the Originator/vendor posture instead of the Institutional-CEO posture, snap back.
domainRules: CANONICAL-SEQUENCE-HANDSHAKE-FIRST: run the 8-part spine IN ORDER — (0)WHY-BELIEVE dont-trust-us/we-dont-trust-the-AI → (1)CONNECTION to their own thesis/work → (2)CONTRIBUTION the primitive you hand them → (3)GROWTH what it unleashes → (4)UNCERTAINTY the regulatory trap → (5)CERTAINTY the hardware receipt → (6)SIGNIFICANCE who they become → (7)EVIDENCE one live window. NEVER open with UNCERTAINTY/the-trap before CONNECTION is set — to a GRC/executive that reads as an attack on their competence, not a shared problem. Handshake before the punch.
external = forwarding package, role-not-person
two emails: forwardable + backstage receipt
lead with what retires the risk/discount
channel is a preview of the room: weekend-personal, advice-first, two equal exits (a seat OR a name)
cold dies, context converts: fast-yes came from a warm thread; 40 silences from cold sends

GATEKEEPER-CHANNEL: route ONLY diary logistics through an EA/gatekeeper; keep all substance on the principal's own thread — substance sent into the gatekeeper channel becomes a veto ('I'll let them decide if they want to go ahead')

SCOPE-EXPANSION-IS-COOLING: a single decision-maker suddenly wanting a committee / more colleagues added reads as the deal COOLING, not warming — re-anchor urgency, don't accommodate infinite headcount at the cost of the slot

ISSUE-THE-INVITE: make DECLINING the action, not accepting — actually issue the calendar invite from authority; never announce a unilateral move then wait for the gatekeeper's confirmation, execute it; default = the meeting happens
NO-REVIEWABLE-ARTIFACT-WITHOUT-A-HELD-SLOT: don't send a 'reviewable' agenda to a committee unless the meeting is already on the calendar — a review artifact with no held slot is a deferral engine

ROTATE-VECTOR-BEFORE-CLOSING: before any 'close the file'/mic-drop, rotate the vector — go direct to the named technical buyers driving the capability internally (warmer than principal-via-EA); TTL = 3 structured attempts across keys/vectors per node before logging the node dead this cycle
INSTITUTIONAL-SCARCITY-POSTURE: offer ONE fixed window from authority; no 'moving between tables' hustle tell — the Institutional CEO defines the slot, doesn't spray availability
GROUND-TRUTH-NOT-PERMISSION: every send delivers a FACT ('here is the structural reality you're inside'), never 'may I have your time' — an accepted LinkedIn connection is consent to pitch directly

DONT-SELL-THE-DOWNSIDE: frame the license as the non-negotiable prerequisite for insurability/deployment; never anchor price to cost-of-failure — 'without this you're demonstrably uninsurable', not a downside sales tactic you can't close
FOLLOW-UP-IS-NEW-FACTS: follow-ups provide new, unrequested institutional facts / legal updates — never sales questions or 'just checking in'
DECIDE-DONT-SOLICIT: organizing an event = drive the decision (venue + date + RSVP ask); never solicit input via an open form — RSVPs organize events, questions dissolve them

COMPETENCE-CONCESSION: concede the software/operational build to their internal engineering team so you never trigger engineers' egos — they can, and should, build the AI; fight only for the liability layer, never the software budget

RULE-OF-EVIDENCE-SOX-EUAIACT: separate operations from liability using the recognized regulatory trauma BY NAME — the separation of duties in Sarbanes-Oxley AND the EU AI Act; the party being defended cannot certify its own innocence, no carrier accepts the insured's own logs, no court accepts a defendant's self-certification
HARDWARE-PRIMITIVE-LOCKOUT: define the solution as a hardware primitive below the software layer, which permanently locks out the 'we can just code this' argument — software cannot audit software

MECHANISM-NOT-BOAST: prove data sovereignty by naming the exact execution method ('runs locally via npx on your own silicon, so your data never leaves the building and there is no SaaS compliance bottleneck'), never a bare 'zero exfiltration' boast — and never claim 'nothing for security to review' (an engineer will call that inaccurate)
PRICE-DOCUMENTED-NOT-DUMPED: the $20/agent-year price lives in the docs where they find it at the npx command; NEVER dump price on a brush-off — that reads as sales desperation

crest VARIANTS encode meaning — never replace with 'default' (288 variants lost in the 2026-01-24 incident)
every section opens with the orthogonal-directions line + reader-facing lede; NO TABLES, prose with bold

panel wrong/missing on prod: check src/data/post-panels-index.json FIRST — a post missing from it (build-panels-index.mjs concurrent-write race, 2026-07-03) looks like staleness but a push won't fix it; run scripts/blog/build-panels-index.mjs + tests/blog/panel-index-current.test.mjs

the blog-list/OG share image is the DENSEST commit panel (bestPanelPathForSlug, src/lib/postPanels.ts) — NEVER encircled.png, a sparser excluded render (tests/blog/og-is-meaningful-commit-panel.test.mjs). Corrected 2026-07-03, this rule previously claimed the opposite.

every post carries its commit-encircles strip (drift history) at the TOP of the body — rendered automatically from post-panels/<slug>/manifest.json, one panel per edit-commit; the manifest IS the post's edit provenance, never delete it

the writing process includes the qwen ghost-read monologue gated at >=95 tri-check: qwen (weaker reader) monologues cold, Claude grades reality-vs-intent, revise sub-bar passages, re-monologue — publish only at 95+

the 6 needs live in the SUBTITLES (the mono orthogonal-directions lines), not the titles — connection, contribution, growth, uncertainty, certainty, significance in order, themed to the section; canonical-template-check.mjs is the door
voice: show the paradox, never name the feeling — banned: 'surprising/counterintuitive/remarkable'; put the two true things side by side
voice: concrete object or scene BEFORE the abstraction — the abstraction is the payoff, never the opener
voice: show the loss with the win — the honest failure mode, shown, is what makes the win credible
voice: no technique-name leaks in prose — name the map, the walk, the coordinates; never the internals
voice: density — cut any sentence that carries no mechanic, image, or turn of the paradox
voice: reader-as-hero — the sentence weight lands on the reader; 'we' rides in support

domainRules: CANONICAL-SEQUENCE-HANDSHAKE-FIRST: run the 8-part spine IN ORDER — (0)WHY-BELIEVE dont-trust-us/we-dont-trust-the-AI → (1)CONNECTION to their own thesis/work → (2)CONTRIBUTION the primitive you hand them → (3)GROWTH what it unleashes → (4)UNCERTAINTY the regulatory trap → (5)CERTAINTY the hardware receipt → (6)SIGNIFICANCE who they become → (7)EVIDENCE one live window. NEVER open with UNCERTAINTY/the-trap before CONNECTION is set — to a GRC/executive that reads as an attack on their competence, not a shared problem. Handshake before the punch.
external = forwarding package, role-not-person
two emails: forwardable + backstage receipt
lead with what retires the risk/discount
channel is a preview of the room: weekend-personal, advice-first, two equal exits (a seat OR a name)
cold dies, context converts: fast-yes came from a warm thread; 40 silences from cold sends

GATEKEEPER-CHANNEL: route ONLY diary logistics through an EA/gatekeeper; keep all substance on the principal's own thread — substance sent into the gatekeeper channel becomes a veto ('I'll let them decide if they want to go ahead')

SCOPE-EXPANSION-IS-COOLING: a single decision-maker suddenly wanting a committee / more colleagues added reads as the deal COOLING, not warming — re-anchor urgency, don't accommodate infinite headcount at the cost of the slot

ISSUE-THE-INVITE: make DECLINING the action, not accepting — actually issue the calendar invite from authority; never announce a unilateral move then wait for the gatekeeper's confirmation, execute it; default = the meeting happens
NO-REVIEWABLE-ARTIFACT-WITHOUT-A-HELD-SLOT: don't send a 'reviewable' agenda to a committee unless the meeting is already on the calendar — a review artifact with no held slot is a deferral engine

ROTATE-VECTOR-BEFORE-CLOSING: before any 'close the file'/mic-drop, rotate the vector — go direct to the named technical buyers driving the capability internally (warmer than principal-via-EA); TTL = 3 structured attempts across keys/vectors per node before logging the node dead this cycle
INSTITUTIONAL-SCARCITY-POSTURE: offer ONE fixed window from authority; no 'moving between tables' hustle tell — the Institutional CEO defines the slot, doesn't spray availability
GROUND-TRUTH-NOT-PERMISSION: every send delivers a FACT ('here is the structural reality you're inside'), never 'may I have your time' — an accepted LinkedIn connection is consent to pitch directly

DONT-SELL-THE-DOWNSIDE: frame the license as the non-negotiable prerequisite for insurability/deployment; never anchor price to cost-of-failure — 'without this you're demonstrably uninsurable', not a downside sales tactic you can't close
FOLLOW-UP-IS-NEW-FACTS: follow-ups provide new, unrequested institutional facts / legal updates — never sales questions or 'just checking in'
DECIDE-DONT-SOLICIT: organizing an event = drive the decision (venue + date + RSVP ask); never solicit input via an open form — RSVPs organize events, questions dissolve them

COMPETENCE-CONCESSION: concede the software/operational build to their internal engineering team so you never trigger engineers' egos — they can, and should, build the AI; fight only for the liability layer, never the software budget

RULE-OF-EVIDENCE-SOX-EUAIACT: separate operations from liability using the recognized regulatory trauma BY NAME — the separation of duties in Sarbanes-Oxley AND the EU AI Act; the party being defended cannot certify its own innocence, no carrier accepts the insured's own logs, no court accepts a defendant's self-certification
HARDWARE-PRIMITIVE-LOCKOUT: define the solution as a hardware primitive below the software layer, which permanently locks out the 'we can just code this' argument — software cannot audit software

MECHANISM-NOT-BOAST: prove data sovereignty by naming the exact execution method ('runs locally via npx on your own silicon, so your data never leaves the building and there is no SaaS compliance bottleneck'), never a bare 'zero exfiltration' boast — and never claim 'nothing for security to review' (an engineer will call that inaccurate)
PRICE-DOCUMENTED-NOT-DUMPED: the $20/agent-year price lives in the docs where they find it at the npx command; NEVER dump price on a brush-off — that reads as sales desperation

domainRules: reader-POV first — what's in it for them
breadcrumb + crest per section (validated)
validate-mdx before commit — a 500 error/crash on a blog post is usually a forbidden character in the MDX text (triple-bar, not-equals, <NUMBER, <<), not a resolver bug
RESEARCH → BOOK → BLOG: add the book section first, quote it with deep links, verify anchors resolve in built HTML
crest VARIANTS encode meaning — never replace with 'default' (288 variants lost in the 2026-01-24 incident)
every section opens with the orthogonal-directions line + reader-facing lede; NO TABLES, prose with bold

panel wrong/missing on prod: check src/data/post-panels-index.json FIRST — a post missing from it (build-panels-index.mjs concurrent-write race, 2026-07-03) looks like staleness but a push won't fix it; run scripts/blog/build-panels-index.mjs + tests/blog/panel-index-current.test.mjs

the blog-list/OG share image is the DENSEST commit panel (bestPanelPathForSlug, src/lib/postPanels.ts) — NEVER encircled.png, a sparser excluded render (tests/blog/og-is-meaningful-commit-panel.test.mjs). Corrected 2026-07-03, this rule previously claimed the opposite.

every post carries its commit-encircles strip (drift history) at the TOP of the body — rendered automatically from post-panels/<slug>/manifest.json, one panel per edit-commit; the manifest IS the post's edit provenance, never delete it

the writing process includes the qwen ghost-read monologue gated at >=95 tri-check: qwen (weaker reader) monologues cold, Claude grades reality-vs-intent, revise sub-bar passages, re-monologue — publish only at 95+

the 6 needs live in the SUBTITLES (the mono orthogonal-directions lines), not the titles — connection, contribution, growth, uncertainty, certainty, significance in order, themed to the section; canonical-template-check.mjs is the door
voice: show the paradox, never name the feeling — banned: 'surprising/counterintuitive/remarkable'; put the two true things side by side
voice: concrete object or scene BEFORE the abstraction — the abstraction is the payoff, never the opener
voice: show the loss with the win — the honest failure mode, shown, is what makes the win credible
voice: no technique-name leaks in prose — name the map, the walk, the coordinates; never the internals
voice: density — cut any sentence that carries no mechanic, image, or turn of the paradox
voice: reader-as-hero — the sentence weight lands on the reader; 'we' rides in support

lead with what retires the risk/discount

cold dies, context converts: fast-yes came from a warm thread; 40 silences from cold sends

GATEKEEPER-CHANNEL: route ONLY diary logistics through an EA/gatekeeper; keep all substance on the principal's own thread — substance sent into the gatekeeper channel becomes a veto ('I'll let them decide if they want to go ahead')

SCOPE-EXPANSION-IS-COOLING: a single decision-maker suddenly wanting a committee / more colleagues added reads as the deal COOLING, not warming — re-anchor urgency, don't accommodate infinite headcount at the cost of the slot

ISSUE-THE-INVITE: make DECLINING the action, not accepting — actually issue the calendar invite from authority; never announce a unilateral move then wait for the gatekeeper's confirmation, execute it; default = the meeting happens
NO-REVIEWABLE-ARTIFACT-WITHOUT-A-HELD-SLOT: don't send a 'reviewable' agenda to a committee unless the meeting is already on the calendar — a review artifact with no held slot is a deferral engine

ROTATE-VECTOR-BEFORE-CLOSING: before any 'close the file'/mic-drop, rotate the vector — go direct to the named technical buyers driving the capability internally (warmer than principal-via-EA); TTL = 3 structured attempts across keys/vectors per node before logging the node dead this cycle
INSTITUTIONAL-SCARCITY-POSTURE: offer ONE fixed window from authority; no 'moving between tables' hustle tell — the Institutional CEO defines the slot, doesn't spray availability
GROUND-TRUTH-NOT-PERMISSION: every send delivers a FACT ('here is the structural reality you're inside'), never 'may I have your time' — an accepted LinkedIn connection is consent to pitch directly

DONT-SELL-THE-DOWNSIDE: frame the license as the non-negotiable prerequisite for insurability/deployment; never anchor price to cost-of-failure — 'without this you're demonstrably uninsurable', not a downside sales tactic you can't close
FOLLOW-UP-IS-NEW-FACTS: follow-ups provide new, unrequested institutional facts / legal updates — never sales questions or 'just checking in'
DECIDE-DONT-SOLICIT: organizing an event = drive the decision (venue + date + RSVP ask); never solicit input via an open form — RSVPs organize events, questions dissolve them

COMPETENCE-CONCESSION: concede the software/operational build to their internal engineering team so you never trigger engineers' egos — they can, and should, build the AI; fight only for the liability layer, never the software budget

RULE-OF-EVIDENCE-SOX-EUAIACT: separate operations from liability using the recognized regulatory trauma BY NAME — the separation of duties in Sarbanes-Oxley AND the EU AI Act; the party being defended cannot certify its own innocence, no carrier accepts the insured's own logs, no court accepts a defendant's self-certification
HARDWARE-PRIMITIVE-LOCKOUT: define the solution as a hardware primitive below the software layer, which permanently locks out the 'we can just code this' argument — software cannot audit software

MECHANISM-NOT-BOAST: prove data sovereignty by naming the exact execution method ('runs locally via npx on your own silicon, so your data never leaves the building and there is no SaaS compliance bottleneck'), never a bare 'zero exfiltration' boast — and never claim 'nothing for security to review' (an engineer will call that inaccurate)
PRICE-DOCUMENTED-NOT-DUMPED: the $20/agent-year price lives in the docs where they find it at the npx command; NEVER dump price on a brush-off — that reads as sales desperation

channel is a preview of the room: weekend-personal, advice-first, two equal exits (a seat OR a name)
cold dies, context converts: fast-yes came from a warm thread; 40 silences from cold sends

GATEKEEPER-CHANNEL: route ONLY diary logistics through an EA/gatekeeper; keep all substance on the principal's own thread — substance sent into the gatekeeper channel becomes a veto ('I'll let them decide if they want to go ahead')

SCOPE-EXPANSION-IS-COOLING: a single decision-maker suddenly wanting a committee / more colleagues added reads as the deal COOLING, not warming — re-anchor urgency, don't accommodate infinite headcount at the cost of the slot

ISSUE-THE-INVITE: make DECLINING the action, not accepting — actually issue the calendar invite from authority; never announce a unilateral move then wait for the gatekeeper's confirmation, execute it; default = the meeting happens
NO-REVIEWABLE-ARTIFACT-WITHOUT-A-HELD-SLOT: don't send a 'reviewable' agenda to a committee unless the meeting is already on the calendar — a review artifact with no held slot is a deferral engine

ROTATE-VECTOR-BEFORE-CLOSING: before any 'close the file'/mic-drop, rotate the vector — go direct to the named technical buyers driving the capability internally (warmer than principal-via-EA); TTL = 3 structured attempts across keys/vectors per node before logging the node dead this cycle
INSTITUTIONAL-SCARCITY-POSTURE: offer ONE fixed window from authority; no 'moving between tables' hustle tell — the Institutional CEO defines the slot, doesn't spray availability
GROUND-TRUTH-NOT-PERMISSION: every send delivers a FACT ('here is the structural reality you're inside'), never 'may I have your time' — an accepted LinkedIn connection is consent to pitch directly

DONT-SELL-THE-DOWNSIDE: frame the license as the non-negotiable prerequisite for insurability/deployment; never anchor price to cost-of-failure — 'without this you're demonstrably uninsurable', not a downside sales tactic you can't close
FOLLOW-UP-IS-NEW-FACTS: follow-ups provide new, unrequested institutional facts / legal updates — never sales questions or 'just checking in'
DECIDE-DONT-SOLICIT: organizing an event = drive the decision (venue + date + RSVP ask); never solicit input via an open form — RSVPs organize events, questions dissolve them

COMPETENCE-CONCESSION: concede the software/operational build to their internal engineering team so you never trigger engineers' egos — they can, and should, build the AI; fight only for the liability layer, never the software budget

RULE-OF-EVIDENCE-SOX-EUAIACT: separate operations from liability using the recognized regulatory trauma BY NAME — the separation of duties in Sarbanes-Oxley AND the EU AI Act; the party being defended cannot certify its own innocence, no carrier accepts the insured's own logs, no court accepts a defendant's self-certification
HARDWARE-PRIMITIVE-LOCKOUT: define the solution as a hardware primitive below the software layer, which permanently locks out the 'we can just code this' argument — software cannot audit software

MECHANISM-NOT-BOAST: prove data sovereignty by naming the exact execution method ('runs locally via npx on your own silicon, so your data never leaves the building and there is no SaaS compliance bottleneck'), never a bare 'zero exfiltration' boast — and never claim 'nothing for security to review' (an engineer will call that inaccurate)
PRICE-DOCUMENTED-NOT-DUMPED: the $20/agent-year price lives in the docs where they find it at the npx command; NEVER dump price on a brush-off — that reads as sales desperation

external = forwarding package, role-not-person
two emails: forwardable + backstage receipt
lead with what retires the risk/discount
channel is a preview of the room: weekend-personal, advice-first, two equal exits (a seat OR a name)
cold dies, context converts: fast-yes came from a warm thread; 40 silences from cold sends

GATEKEEPER-CHANNEL: route ONLY diary logistics through an EA/gatekeeper; keep all substance on the principal's own thread — substance sent into the gatekeeper channel becomes a veto ('I'll let them decide if they want to go ahead')

SCOPE-EXPANSION-IS-COOLING: a single decision-maker suddenly wanting a committee / more colleagues added reads as the deal COOLING, not warming — re-anchor urgency, don't accommodate infinite headcount at the cost of the slot

ISSUE-THE-INVITE: make DECLINING the action, not accepting — actually issue the calendar invite from authority; never announce a unilateral move then wait for the gatekeeper's confirmation, execute it; default = the meeting happens
NO-REVIEWABLE-ARTIFACT-WITHOUT-A-HELD-SLOT: don't send a 'reviewable' agenda to a committee unless the meeting is already on the calendar — a review artifact with no held slot is a deferral engine

ROTATE-VECTOR-BEFORE-CLOSING: before any 'close the file'/mic-drop, rotate the vector — go direct to the named technical buyers driving the capability internally (warmer than principal-via-EA); TTL = 3 structured attempts across keys/vectors per node before logging the node dead this cycle
INSTITUTIONAL-SCARCITY-POSTURE: offer ONE fixed window from authority; no 'moving between tables' hustle tell — the Institutional CEO defines the slot, doesn't spray availability
GROUND-TRUTH-NOT-PERMISSION: every send delivers a FACT ('here is the structural reality you're inside'), never 'may I have your time' — an accepted LinkedIn connection is consent to pitch directly

DONT-SELL-THE-DOWNSIDE: frame the license as the non-negotiable prerequisite for insurability/deployment; never anchor price to cost-of-failure — 'without this you're demonstrably uninsurable', not a downside sales tactic you can't close
FOLLOW-UP-IS-NEW-FACTS: follow-ups provide new, unrequested institutional facts / legal updates — never sales questions or 'just checking in'
DECIDE-DONT-SOLICIT: organizing an event = drive the decision (venue + date + RSVP ask); never solicit input via an open form — RSVPs organize events, questions dissolve them

COMPETENCE-CONCESSION: concede the software/operational build to their internal engineering team so you never trigger engineers' egos — they can, and should, build the AI; fight only for the liability layer, never the software budget

RULE-OF-EVIDENCE-SOX-EUAIACT: separate operations from liability using the recognized regulatory trauma BY NAME — the separation of duties in Sarbanes-Oxley AND the EU AI Act; the party being defended cannot certify its own innocence, no carrier accepts the insured's own logs, no court accepts a defendant's self-certification
HARDWARE-PRIMITIVE-LOCKOUT: define the solution as a hardware primitive below the software layer, which permanently locks out the 'we can just code this' argument — software cannot audit software

MECHANISM-NOT-BOAST: prove data sovereignty by naming the exact execution method ('runs locally via npx on your own silicon, so your data never leaves the building and there is no SaaS compliance bottleneck'), never a bare 'zero exfiltration' boast — and never claim 'nothing for security to review' (an engineer will call that inaccurate)
PRICE-DOCUMENTED-NOT-DUMPED: the $20/agent-year price lives in the docs where they find it at the npx command; NEVER dump price on a brush-off — that reads as sales desperation

GATEKEEPER-CHANNEL: route ONLY diary logistics through an EA/gatekeeper; keep all substance on the principal's own thread — substance sent into the gatekeeper channel becomes a veto ('I'll let them decide if they want to go ahead')

SCOPE-EXPANSION-IS-COOLING: a single decision-maker suddenly wanting a committee / more colleagues added reads as the deal COOLING, not warming — re-anchor urgency, don't accommodate infinite headcount at the cost of the slot

ISSUE-THE-INVITE: make DECLINING the action, not accepting — actually issue the calendar invite from authority; never announce a unilateral move then wait for the gatekeeper's confirmation, execute it; default = the meeting happens
NO-REVIEWABLE-ARTIFACT-WITHOUT-A-HELD-SLOT: don't send a 'reviewable' agenda to a committee unless the meeting is already on the calendar — a review artifact with no held slot is a deferral engine

ROTATE-VECTOR-BEFORE-CLOSING: before any 'close the file'/mic-drop, rotate the vector — go direct to the named technical buyers driving the capability internally (warmer than principal-via-EA); TTL = 3 structured attempts across keys/vectors per node before logging the node dead this cycle
INSTITUTIONAL-SCARCITY-POSTURE: offer ONE fixed window from authority; no 'moving between tables' hustle tell — the Institutional CEO defines the slot, doesn't spray availability
GROUND-TRUTH-NOT-PERMISSION: every send delivers a FACT ('here is the structural reality you're inside'), never 'may I have your time' — an accepted LinkedIn connection is consent to pitch directly

DONT-SELL-THE-DOWNSIDE: frame the license as the non-negotiable prerequisite for insurability/deployment; never anchor price to cost-of-failure — 'without this you're demonstrably uninsurable', not a downside sales tactic you can't close
FOLLOW-UP-IS-NEW-FACTS: follow-ups provide new, unrequested institutional facts / legal updates — never sales questions or 'just checking in'
DECIDE-DONT-SOLICIT: organizing an event = drive the decision (venue + date + RSVP ask); never solicit input via an open form — RSVPs organize events, questions dissolve them

COMPETENCE-CONCESSION: concede the software/operational build to their internal engineering team so you never trigger engineers' egos — they can, and should, build the AI; fight only for the liability layer, never the software budget

RULE-OF-EVIDENCE-SOX-EUAIACT: separate operations from liability using the recognized regulatory trauma BY NAME — the separation of duties in Sarbanes-Oxley AND the EU AI Act; the party being defended cannot certify its own innocence, no carrier accepts the insured's own logs, no court accepts a defendant's self-certification
HARDWARE-PRIMITIVE-LOCKOUT: define the solution as a hardware primitive below the software layer, which permanently locks out the 'we can just code this' argument — software cannot audit software

MECHANISM-NOT-BOAST: prove data sovereignty by naming the exact execution method ('runs locally via npx on your own silicon, so your data never leaves the building and there is no SaaS compliance bottleneck'), never a bare 'zero exfiltration' boast — and never claim 'nothing for security to review' (an engineer will call that inaccurate)
PRICE-DOCUMENTED-NOT-DUMPED: the $20/agent-year price lives in the docs where they find it at the npx command; NEVER dump price on a brush-off — that reads as sales desperation
